note: _haurieteis aquas de fontibus salvatoris_ – you shall draw waters out of the Saviour’s fountains; ihr werdet Wasser schöpfen aus den Quellen des Erlösers. The Hebrew text merely refers to the “fountains of salvation.” Jerome changes the sentence so as to have a messianic prophecy. – Albert Condamin SJ: Les caractères de la traduction de la Bible de saint Jérôme. _Recherches de science religieuse_ 3 (1912) 105–138, at p. 133.
